skills.name: web-environment
skills.description: Stand up or locate the runnable web target on port 4321 (astro dev); hard-refresh, cache discipline, kill stale servers. Triggers: 'start the dev server', 'the page is stale'.

skills.name: web-reproduce
skills.description: Web reproduce recipes per layer/subtype: computed-style read, scrollWidth vs clientWidth, console read, interaction+state assertion, viewport/resize matrix. Internal: engine reproduce step.

skills.name: web-verify
skills.description: Web verify recipes that mirror reproduce; when ~~browser is absent emit handoff/v0 with a UI LAYER_METHODS proof. Triggers (internal): orchestrator verify step on a web bug.

skills.name: web-source-map
skills.description: Symptom -> file hints on an Astro + content-collections stack: overflow, dead interaction, layout gap, content-not-updating. Triggers (internal): orchestrator isolate step on a web bug.
